name: cdn-sni-allowlist
description: On Cloudflare's addresses only ONE name may be opened: any other ClientHello to an edge — including every ECH hello, whose outer name is cloudflare-ech.com — is reset. The relay's own address is not under the rule. Op cdn: the CDN route is dead (the plan says the add-on does not rescue an SNI allowlist phase), and it does not fall back to a plain hello (the zone name is not on the list either, and the censor's log would show it).
analogue: net4people #626: Cloudflare addresses open for one name only during an allowlist phase. Plan §2.1: 'cloudflare-ech.com is not on such a list'. Model: an exact allowlist on the edge prefix, reassembling, RST both ways; flows that carry no ClientHello are let through. Not modelled: allowlists keyed on the certificate or on the HTTP Host.
